name: Arcturus Defense Solutions Specter Rifle SR-6 'Whisper'
description:
The SR-6 Whisper is Arcturus' integrally suppressed assault rifle, designed for operations where sound discipline is paramount. Unlike rifles with detachable suppressors, the Whisper's barrel is permanently enclosed in a suppression shroud that bleeds propellant gases through a series of expansion chambers along the barrel's full length. Combined with subsonic 6.5mm ammunition, the weapon produces less noise than a closing car door.

The BCI integration includes a sound-profile analyzer that monitors the weapon's acoustic signature in real-time and alerts the operator if suppression efficiency degrades. The rifle also features a thermal masking system that circulates coolant through the suppression shroud, reducing the infrared signature of the heated barrel to near-ambient levels within seconds of firing.

Arcturus developed the Whisper for their deniable operations division — the arm of corporate security that conducts actions that officially never happened. The weapon's combination of acoustic and thermal suppression makes detection by surveillance systems extremely difficult. After an engagement, the SR-6 leaves minimal forensic signature — subsonic rounds fragment on impact, and the integrally suppressed design captures residue that would otherwise contaminate the shooter.
legality: Highly restricted — deniable operations authorization only
specifications: caliber: 6.5mm subsonic caseless effective_range: 300m rate_of_fire: 650 rpm (cyclic) magazine_capacity: 25 rounds weight: 4.2 kg
tactical_use: The SR-6 is optimized for covert engagements where discovery means mission failure. Its combined acoustic and thermal suppression defeats both human senses and electronic surveillance, allowing operators to engage targets in monitored environments without triggering alarms. The subsonic ammunition limits range and penetration compared to standard loads, but within its operational envelope the Whisper is nearly undetectable.
cultural_context: The Whisper's existence is technically classified, though its use in enough deniable operations has made it an open secret. In intelligence circles, being told someone carries a Whisper is a warning: the person holding it operates outside normal rules of engagement. The weapon has no legitimate civilian or standard military application — it exists solely to kill quietly and leave no evidence.
story_hooks: A Whisper was recovered from a crime scene that Arcturus claims is impossible — the weapon's serial number belongs to a unit that was supposedly destroyed in a decommissioning audit three years ago.
An operator realizes their SR-6's BCI acoustic monitor has been recording and transmitting their location every time they fire — the weapon has been tracking its own user.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, tapered assault rifle with an unusually bulbous forward section that gradually narrows toward the muzzle. The suppression shroud dominates the weapon's visual presence, creating a distinctive silhouette that suggests advanced thermal management. The overall aesthetic is deliberately understated—form follows function, with no aggressive angles or tactical flash. It reads as clinical, almost surgical.
physical_description.dimensions: Total length: 94 cm | Barrel length (integral): 38 cm | Suppression shroud outer diameter: 6.5 cm (tapering) | Magazine well depth: 8 cm
physical_description.weight_description: Balanced and manageable at 4.2 kg—noticeably lighter than conventional assault rifles due to the caseless ammunition system and composite construction. Feels front-weighted due to the suppression shroud's mass, but the weight is distributed smoothly along the barrel, creating a natural pivot point near the operator's support hand.
physical_description.primary_material: Carbon-fiber composite frame with aerospace-grade aluminum suppression shroud. Bolt carrier and internal mechanisms are hardened steel. Caseless ammunition feed system uses polymer-composite magazines.
physical_description.finish: Matte graphite with subtle iridescent cooling-line patterns visible under direct light—evidence of the thermal-circulating system beneath the surface. The suppression shroud has a slightly honeycomb texture where cooling channels indent the exterior. Intentionally non-reflective to defeat optics scanning.
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal gray primary | Deep charcoal accents | Faint cyan LED indicators visible through translucent polymer ports along the suppression shroud
physical_description.grip_texture: Textured polymer grip with micro-serrations for secure purchase with gloved hands. The handguard features a woven carbon-fiber overlay that provides tactile feedback without creating friction noise. Upper receiver has subtle grip-zone indentations.
distinctive_features: Integral suppression shroud with visible radial cooling fins
Three small cyan LED indicator ports (one per section of shroud) showing real-time acoustic and thermal efficiency
Recessed muzzle end—no visible brake or flash hider, just a slightly beveled opening
Modular BCI socket integrated into the upper receiver (rear-mounted, unobtrusive)
Caseless ammunition port with polymer dust cover
Thermal circulation access ports along suppression shroud (sealed with flush-fit plugs)
Ambidextrous safety selector with subtle mechanical click
Low-profile integrated rail system (4x attachment points) rather than traditional Picatinny—intentionally minimal to reduce acoustic reflection
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Arcturus Defense Solutions logo (stylized 'A' star) laser-etched on the lower receiver, barely visible in low light. 'WHISPER SR-6' designation stamped on the suppression shroud in minimalist sans-serif font. Serial number (20-character alphanumeric) on the inside of the magazine well—deliberately hidden from casual observation. BCG Blackwood Commercial Group ownership plate affixed to the stock with flush screws.
physical_description.condition_typical: Immaculate. These weapons are issued to deniable operations teams with strict maintenance protocols. Any unit in the field shows zero cosmetic wear—the matte finish and dark coloration hide even microscopic blemishes. Internal mechanisms are pristine due to advanced polymer components and sealed bearing systems. After firing, residue containment means the weapon remains externally clean.
